import BusyBeaver.ZFC.InductiveAttempts
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.Code254GIC

open SetTheory SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC

#print axioms InductiveAttempts.agree_of_separator
#print axioms InductiveAttempts.base_attempt
#print axioms InductiveAttempts.extend_attempt
#print axioms InductiveAttempts.attempts_exist_of_separator
#print axioms InductiveAttempts.closure_of_instances
#print axioms InductiveAttempts.sat_attemptForm
#print axioms InductiveAttempts.sat_agreeForm
#print axioms InductiveAttempts.sat_hasAttemptForm
#print axioms InductiveAttempts.sat_valueForm
#print axioms InductiveAttempts.agreement_separator
#print axioms InductiveAttempts.existence_separator
#print axioms InductiveAttempts.value_image
#print axioms InductiveAttempts.closure_of_forms
#print axioms InductiveAttempts.point_graph
#print axioms InductiveAttempts.extend_graph
#print axioms InductiveAttempts.successor_closure
#print axioms InductiveAttempts.ordinary_infinity_of_container
#print axioms InductiveAttempts.quotientFiniteBase
#print axioms InductiveAttempts.quotient_infinity
#print axioms InductiveAttempts.quotient_inf_form

example {V : Type} (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V)
    (h : ProfileModel.ModelsCPGIC mem) :
    ∃ I, (∃ e0, QuotientModel.quotientMember mem witness h e0 I ∧
        ∀ z, ¬ QuotientModel.quotientMember mem witness h z e0) ∧
      ∀ x, QuotientModel.quotientMember mem witness h x I →
        ∃ sx, QuotientModel.quotientMember mem witness h sx I ∧
          ∀ t, QuotientModel.quotientMember mem witness h t sx ↔
            QuotientModel.quotientMember mem witness h t x ∨ t = x :=
  InductiveAttempts.quotient_infinity mem witness h

example {V : Type} (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V)
    (h : ProfileModel.ModelsCPGIC mem) :
    ∀ env, Sat (QuotientModel.quotientMember mem witness h) env (sealF Inf_form) :=
  seal_valid Inf_form |>.mpr (InductiveAttempts.quotient_inf_form mem witness h)

example {V : Type} (mem : V → V → Prop) (hirr : ∀ x, ¬ mem x x) (witness : V)
    (hB : ∀ f, Code254.EncBundle f → ∀ e : Nat → V, Tarski.Sat mem e f) :
    let h := Code254GIC.modelsCPGIC_of_encBundle mem hirr (fun _ => witness) hB
    ∀ env, Sat (QuotientModel.quotientMember mem witness h) env Inf_form :=
  InductiveAttempts.quotient_inf_form mem witness
    (Code254GIC.modelsCPGIC_of_encBundle mem hirr (fun _ => witness) hB)
